## What I Build

### Landing Pages (Figma + Framer)
High-converting landing pages designed in Figma with strategic UX copy, built pixel-perfect in Framer. 3-4 pages, responsive, SEO-ready. Starting at $1,000.

### Multi-Page Websites (Figma + Framer + CMS)
Full websites with 5-8+ pages, CMS, blog, and dynamic content. Designed in Figma with conversion-focused UX copy. $2,000 - $5,000.

### Chrome Extensions
Standalone Chrome extensions built from scratch with React and Manifest V3. Productivity tools, SaaS companions, workflow automations. Custom pricing.

### UX Copywriting
Headlines, CTAs, value props, page flow, and microcopy. Written as part of the design process to maximize conversions.
